observations.observed: Complete image of the Japanese Expansion Sheet 1 (vending) カビゴン LV.35 HP90, とおせんぼ and ねころぶ 30, Illus. Keita Takahashi, No. 143 followed by the diamond Uncommon rarity symbol. Unlike the Quick Starter Gift Set printing (SPEC-0200), the face carries no CoroCoro Comic Illust Contest credit. Retained as the image of the 1998-03-23 vending printing; no finish is inferred from it.
